question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

White elephant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Costly but useless possession**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **White Elephant** means any burdensome, expensive and useless possession that is much more trouble than it is worth.

 
 
• **Example-** *That theatre is a real **white elephant**. It cost millions to build and nobody ever goes there.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'White elephant'** is **'Costly but useless possession.'**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.
